name: bawwab
description: Bawwab — Self-hosted AI Gateway. Clone, setup, and run locally.

scripts.install:all: cd api && npm install && cd ../dashboard && npm install
scripts.build: cd api && npm run build && cd ../dashboard && npm run build
scripts.start: cd api && mkdir -p data && npm start
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd api && npm run dev" "cd dashboard && npm run dev"
